source_of_truth.base_context: Protected PR #85 is merged; T036 and T039 are checked while T034, T035, T037, T038, T040 and T041 are unchecked on authoritative main.

implementation_subject.meaning: This commit and tree identify the accepted coupled T034-T035 runtime, tests and generated contract before candidate-only evidence metadata is added.

acceptance_matrix.proof: The attributable T034 content domain/application/persistence boundaries remain in use; public-visible plainText and deterministic mixed-language readingTimeMinutes are derived from the immutable article snapshot content.

acceptance_matrix.criterion: Anonymous public Article API and named controller boundary
acceptance_matrix.proof: GET /api/v1/public/articles/{articleSlug} remains published-only and anonymous, and PublicArticleController plus its representation ETag helper now reside under content/api as named by T035.

acceptance_matrix.criterion: Immutable publication snapshot and stable ETag
acceptance_matrix.proof: The read model resolves the revision pinned by the latest immutable Issue snapshot and the matching append-only Article snapshot. Direct live pointer/title/body drift leaves the response and ETag unchanged; appending a new publication snapshot changes the representation and ETag.

Previous/next candidates come from frozen Issue snapshot sections and Article snapshot content rather than issue_article or live revision content. The selected issueSnapshotId is carried across the two read steps so a concurrent publication cannot mix snapshots.

ArticleProjection declares origin-neutral canonicalPath plus publishedAt and updatedAt derived from immutable snapshot timestamps; the configured web origin remains the only authority for constructing an absolute canonical URL.
Only READY, safe-path, currently valid PUBLIC_WEB variants are returned, now with the authoritative rights-record credit included in the public model, contract and ETag.

acceptance_matrix.criterion: Public contract and conditional response headers
acceptance_matrix.proof: OpenAPI and the generated TypeScript client declare canonicalPath, publication timestamps, media credit and the Article 200 ETag header; 304 behavior remains declared and tested.

red.failure_signature: Exactly the three new T035 records failed: live drift changed ETag, live TOC/body drift changed the response, and canonical/publication/credit fields were absent.
red.unrelated_jobs: Frontend/contract, browser, CodeQL and Trivy passed.

reviewed_green.focused_api_regression: PublicArticleApiIT 11/11 within the successful full Java suite.

review.method: Changed-scope correctness, architecture, security and optimization review

resolved_findings.finding: Two separate reads could select different latest Issue snapshots during a concurrent publication.
resolved_findings.remediation: The content projection now carries the exact selected issueSnapshotId and navigation queries that immutable row.

security_notes: Article slug remains a parameterized query input.
Absolute canonical URLs are not derived from an untrusted Host header.
Media paths remain server-selected, bounded and rights-gated.
Malformed or rights-ineligible published content fails closed.

supersedes_interpretation.scope: The earlier T034 proof correctly established immutable published content projection from article.published_revision_id. The coupled T035 boundary now makes the Issue publication snapshot's revisionId authoritative, with the published pointer retained only as a legacy-snapshot fallback.

T037, T038, T040 and T041 retain their independent acceptance gaps and remain outside this PR.
task_completion_effect: T034 remains checked and T035 is checked only as PR candidates after every named criterion passed on the immutable reviewed implementation subject. Authoritative completion requires protected merge and main read-back.
